description: Browse adoptable pets by location, search by name, or fetch individual pet profiles from bestfriends.org.

age.description: Only emit pets in this age group.
age.title: Age

animalIds.description: Best Friends animal IDs from pet profile URLs, e.g. `214192932`. Looked up through the live adoptable sitemap, so Sanctuary IDs work too.
animalIds.title: Animal IDs (mode=byIds)

color.description: Only emit pets with this coat color (mode=byLocation, mode=search). Labels match the website's own color filter.
enum: Black with Brown, Red, Golden, Orange or Chestnut
Black with Tan, Yellow or Fawn
White with Tan, Yellow or Fawn
enumTitles: Black with Brown, Red, Golden, Orange or Chestnut
Black with Tan, Yellow or Fawn
White with Tan, Yellow or Fawn
color.title: Color

enrichDetails.description: Fetch each pet's profile page for species, description, photos, birthdate and adoption link. When off, records contain card-level data only.
enrichDetails.title: Fetch full profile details

location.description: Adoption center or the Kanab Sanctuary (mode=byLocation, mode=byIds). Non-dog/cat species are listed at the Sanctuary.
location.title: Location

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. The whole site currently lists about 1,600 pets, so 5,000 can capture everything.
maxItems.title: Max items

placement.description: Where the pet is cared for (mode=byLocation, mode=search).
placement.title: Placement

primaryBreed.description: Exact breed label from the website's filter, e.g. `Husky` or `Domestic Shorthair` (mode=byLocation, mode=search). Leave empty for all breeds.
primaryBreed.title: Primary breed / looks like

searchQuery.description: Pet name or partial name (mode=search; also narrows mode=byLocation). Case-insensitive, e.g. `amaranth`. Leave empty for all pets.
searchQuery.title: Search query

secondaryBreed.description: Exact secondary-breed label from the website's filter, e.g. `Mix` or `Boxer` (mode=byLocation, mode=search). Leave empty for any.
secondaryBreed.title: Secondary breed

sex.description: Only emit pets of this sex.
sex.title: Sex

size.description: Only emit pets of this size (mode=byLocation, mode=search).
size.title: Size

species.description: Only emit this species. Dog and Cat work at every location; Rabbit, Bird, Pig, Horse, Barnyard and Other are Kanab Sanctuary categories.
species.title: Species

startUrls.description: Full pet profile URLs, e.g. `https://bestfriends.org/salt-lake-city/adopt/214192932/alfalfa` or `https://bestfriends.org/sanctuary/adopt/8484237/queen-bee`.
startUrls.title: Animal profile URLs (mode=byUrls)

title: Best Friends Animal Society Scraper Input
